parameter_evidence: Zaghloul2024 HTML sec3.3: train67/test33; sec3.4 validation unspecified; sec4.3.3 Grid Search, Table3 model seeds33 only. CV/seed require explicitly documented project adaptation.
cohort: all 96470 eligible completed deliveries; retain all 306 targets above 60 days
preprocessing: fit imputation, encoding, scaling and learned feature selection on each fitting partition only
metric: MAE in days; retain RMSE, R2, bias, error-window and tail diagnostics
population_interpretation: held-out orders from the same historical mixture, not prospective later-month performance
known_data_reuse: This archive and some former holdout outcomes have already informed development. A new random holdout is not a completely untouched external confirmation.
stacking_scope: aligned OOF handoff; stacking fitting remains separate

paper_reported_settings.tuning: Grid Search; full search grid not reported

settings_origin: Project choices authorized by the instruction to start these plans; seed33/CV5 are not reported paper split/CV settings.

implementation.selection: training-only five-fold MAE; bounded staged development; all test candidates frozen together
implementation.feature_selection: fold-local MI; explicit discrete mask; 25/50/75/100% encoded columns
implementation.absolute_loss_implementation: matched HistGradientBoosting squared/absolute losses; RF L1 is omitted for documented compute cost
implementation.OOF: fixed-config training OOF; candidate selection uses these development folds, not nested assessment
implementation.quantile: ordinary gradient boosting quantiles, not Salari asymmetric-split QRF replication

authorized_project_adaptations.explanation: Training-only five-fold validation and seed33 were project choices authorized for these trials; neither is a paper-reported split/CV parameter.
